symptom: v29 passed candidate validation, materialization, full-pack preflight, static balance budget without warnings, playable coverage audit, GameCore validate-content, and the standard 300s / 10-seed all-Bot matrix for seeds 70000-70009. A separate 300s / 10-seed expansion for seeds 71000-71009 returned repair: KiteBot was too stable at 90.0% against the high-skill 45%-75% target, ZoneControlBot was too weak at 20.0% against the mid-skill 25%-55% target, and RouteBot was too successful at 40.0% against the low-skill 10%-35% target.
root_cause: The v27-v29 content repairs completed playable coverage and static budget hygiene, and the 70000-70009 window shows the main Frosting Grassland 300s balance band can land correctly. The 71000-71009 window shows the remaining issue is seed-window robustness around the 210-300s Boss-after pressure and route-safety shape: kite-safe builds over-stabilize, zone-control builds do not convert enough control into wins, and fixed-route builds still find too many safe recoveries. Earlier exploratory probes showed that global Candy Crystal Lance buffs, broad Boss softening, or simple post-Boss wave relief overcorrect other bots, so v30 should use narrow content changes instead of broad weapon or Boss tuning.
fix: Keep v29 in generated_candidates only; do not promote it into accepted_content, Runtime content, or final playtest acceptance. Create a v30 candidate that nudges the 210-300s Frosting Grassland window: reduce excessive kite-safe stabilization, slightly improve zone-control payoff or reliability, and reduce fixed-route safety without hurting CowardBot, GreedyXpBot, TankBot, or BossHunterBot target bands. Avoid global weapon buffs, broad XP cuts, Boss nerfs, or Harness threshold changes.
validation: Completed candidate validation, materialization, full-pack preflight, static balance budget, playable coverage audit, GameCore validate-content, 300s / 3-seed all-Bot matrix on 71000-71002, standard 300s / 10-seed all-Bot matrix on 70000-70009, and 300s / 10-seed all-Bot expansion on 71000-71009. v29 remains repair because the 71000 expansion has KiteBot, ZoneControlBot, and RouteBot outside target. The next viable v30 gate should keep Coward and Route between 10%-35%, Greedy / Tank / ZoneControl between 25%-55%, Kite / BossHunter between 45%-75%, and Idle / Random inside their floor bands before Replay regression, design review, manual playtest, or acceptance can be claimed.
